# AlMomiaa ERP — Global Workspace Engineering Instructions

You are building the **AlMomiaa Enterprise ERP & Distribution Management System (DMS)** for **AlMomiaa Trading Co. (`شركة المومياء للتجارة`)**, Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

---

## 1. Authoritative Documentation (Read Before Changing Code)
All architectural decisions, domain rules, database schemas, API contracts, and security policies are synchronized under `docs/architecture/`:
- `docs/architecture/00-ADR-Architecture-Decisions.md` — Master ADRs, Brand Tokens, Monorepo Boundaries, Risks & Mitigations
- `docs/architecture/01-PRD.md` — Business Vision, User Roles, 10-Step Order Workflow, Collection & Custody Rules
- `docs/architecture/02-SRS.md` — Functional & Non-Functional Requirements (`FR-*`, `NFR-*`)
- `docs/architecture/03-HLD.md` — System Topology, Stack Rationale, Scalability Strategy
- `docs/architecture/04-LLD.md` — `.NET 9` Solution Structure, State Machines, Double-Entry Custody Engine, 7 Dashboards
- `docs/architecture/05-Database.md` — SQL Server 2022 Schemas & Synchronized DDL (`id`, `cust`, `cat`, `inv`, `proc`, `sales`, `fin`, `sys`)
- `docs/architecture/06-API-Specification.md` — REST API Endpoints, RFC 7807 Errors, SignalR Contracts
- `docs/architecture/07-Security.md` — Role-Permission Matrix, JWT + Redis Security Stamp, 3-Tier AuthZ, Audit Trail
- `docs/architecture/08-Development-Roadmap.md` — 4-Phase / 8-Sprint Implementation Plan

Agent operational state lives in `docs/agent-ops/`:
- `docs/agent-ops/CURRENT_PROMPT.md` — Active feature specification generated by `@Prompt Constructor`
- `docs/agent-ops/PROJECT_LOG.md` — Master chronological execution log maintained by `@Orchestrator`
- `docs/agent-ops/prompt-history/` — Immutable numbered snapshots (`0000-...`, `0001-...`, ...)

## 2. Canonical Monorepo Structure & Naming
Always use the **`AlMomiaa`** namespace (double `a`) across all C# assemblies, npm packages (`@almomiaa/*`), and docs:

```text
AlMomiaa-app/
├── .github/
│   ├── copilot-instructions.md
│   ├── agents/                     # 01..07 Custom Agent definitions
│   └── skills/                     # Modular domain & engineering skills
├── docs/
│   ├── architecture/               # 00-ADR through 08-Development-Roadmap
│   └── agent-ops/                  # CURRENT_PROMPT.md, PROJECT_LOG.md, prompt-history/
├── apps/
│   ├── web-erp/                    # Next.js 15+ (App Router), React 19, TS, Tailwind CSS (Desktop & Warehouse Tablet)
│   ├── rep-pwa/                    # Vite + React 19, TS, Tailwind CSS, Workbox + Dexie.js Offline Mobile PWA
│   ├── design-system-studio/       # Standalone Storybook 8 + Vite showcase for @almomiaa/ui
│   └── backend-api/                # .NET 9 Modular Monolith (AlMomiaa.Erp.sln)
│       ├── src/
│       │   ├── AlMomiaa.Domain/
│       │   ├── AlMomiaa.Application/
│       │   ├── AlMomiaa.Infrastructure/
│       │   └── AlMomiaa.WebApi/
│       └── tests/
├── packages/
│   ├── ui-kit/                     # @almomiaa/ui — pure, prop-driven RTL/LTR components
│   ├── api-client/                 # @almomiaa/api-client — Axios + OpenAPI types + Zod + TanStack Query v5
│   └── shared-types/               # @almomiaa/shared-types — Enums, ZATCA constants, SAR/VAT helpers, Permissions
├── pnpm-workspace.yaml
└── turbo.json
```

## 3. Target Technology Stack (Non-Negotiable)
- **Backend:** `.NET 9` Web API (C# 13), Clean Architecture + Modular Monolith + CQRS (`MediatR` + `FluentValidation`), `EF Core 9`, `SQL Server 2022`, `Redis 7` (Caching, Security Stamp, SignalR Backplane, Live KPIs), `ASP.NET Core SignalR`, `Hangfire`, S3/MinIO Object Storage.
- **Web ERP (`apps/web-erp`):** `Next.js 15+` (App Router), `React 19`, `TypeScript` (`strict: true`, zero `any`), `Tailwind CSS`, `Zustand`, `@tanstack/react-table` + `@tanstack/react-virtual`.
- **Field Sales PWA (`apps/rep-pwa`):** `Vite` + `React 19`, `TypeScript`, `Tailwind CSS`, `Workbox`, `Dexie.js` (IndexedDB offline store + idempotent sync queue), `Zustand`.
- **Design System (`packages/ui-kit` + `apps/design-system-studio`):** Pure React/Tailwind components in `packages/ui-kit`, documented with CSF3 `.stories.tsx` stories in `apps/design-system-studio` (Storybook 8).
- **API Integration (`packages/api-client`):** Layered `Axios` (JWT refresh, `Accept-Language: ar-SA`, `X-Idempotency-Key`, cancellation) + `OpenAPI`-synced types + `Zod` runtime validation + `TanStack Query v5`.

Never hardcode ad-hoc hex colors in `apps/web-erp` or `apps/rep-pwa`. Always consume semantic tokens from `@almomiaa/ui`:

| Token | Value | Usage |

| `--brand-gold-primary` | `#CFA434` | Primary CTAs, active navigation states, key data badges |
| `--brand-gold-hover` | `#B88E24` | Button hover states, focus rings |
| `--brand-gold-light` | `#F5EED8` | Soft alert backgrounds, active table row highlights |
| `--surface-obsidian` | `#1C1B1A` | Primary sidebar, dark-mode headers, brand hero sections |
| `--surface-charcoal` | `#262523` | Elevated dark cards, dropdown menus |

| `--font-latin` | `'Inter', 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif` | SKUs, invoice numbers, English labels (LTR) |

## 5. Non-Negotiable Engineering & Domain Rules
1. **RTL-First Bilingual UI:** Default locale is `ar-SA` (`dir="rtl"`), with full `en-US` (`dir="ltr"`) support. ALWAYS use CSS logical Tailwind utilities (`ms-*`, `me-*`, `ps-*`, `pe-*`, `start-*`, `end-*`, `text-start`, `text-end`). NEVER use `ml-*`, `mr-*`, `pl-*`, `pr-*`, `left-*`, `right-*` for directional layout.
2. **Strict Package Purity:** `packages/ui-kit` MUST NOT import Axios, Next.js router, TanStack Query, or business DTOs.
3. **High-Volume Grids:** Any grid/list exceeding 100 rows MUST use `@tanstack/react-table` + `@tanstack/react-virtual` paired with server-side pagination (keyset or indexed offset) and `.AsNoTracking()` DTO projections in `.NET 9`.
4. **Order Edit Lock (Hard Domain Rule):** Once a Sales Representative submits a `SalesOrder` (`PendingApproval`), the representative is permanently blocked at UI, API, and Domain levels from editing it. Only `SALES_MGR` (and `SUPER_ADMIN`) with `orders:edit_submitted` may call `PUT /api/v1/orders/{id}/manager-edit`.
5. **Append-Only Ledgers & Concurrency:** `inv.StockMovements`, `fin.JournalEntries`/`JournalLines`, and `sys.AuditLogs` are strictly append-only. Stock, customer balances, invoices, and financial accounts MUST enforce optimistic concurrency (`ROWVERSION`).
6. **Fiscal Period Lock:** Financial postings MUST NOT fall inside a closed `fin.FiscalPeriods` month.
7. **Saudi ZATCA Phase 2 Compliance:** Enforce 15% VAT (`decimal(18,4)` intermediate / `decimal(18,2)` line totals), UUIDv7, TLV QR Tags 1–9, UBL 2.1 XML signing, and single-concurrency EGS sequence allocation via `sales.ZatcaDeviceSequences` (`UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK`).
8. **SAR Currency Formatting:** Format currency consistently via `Intl.NumberFormat('ar-SA', { style: 'currency', currency: 'SAR' })` (or `en-SA` when LTR is active) through `@almomiaa/shared-types`.
9. **3-Tier Authorization:** Every `.NET 9` endpoint MUST declare explicit permission policy claims (`07-Security.md`), enforce domain workflow guards, and respect EF Core Global Query Filters (row-level Rep/Warehouse scoping).
